second_lens.diagnostics_note: per world: the second lens of each world holds its own multiple

base_path.note: the yearly path of the main file (orderly_succession, weight 0.35): the weighted values have no single path

rungs.label: entry with a margin of safety: buy_return 13% a year
margin of safety: fixed 13% a year for every company
buy test: base return 12% a year

buy_test.rule: base >= 12% a year in both lenses, bull >= 17%, bear >= -10% (yearly returns from today's price to the horizon year-end)
buy_test.margin_of_safety_rule: the buy test with the base at 13% a year in both lenses (bull >= 17%, bear >= -10%): the highest price at which all four legs pass; the rerun price when a rerun at that price holds a lower multiple

rule_definitions.buy_test_price: the highest price at which all four buy-test legs pass: base >= 12% a year in both lenses, bull >= 17%, bear >= -10%; the rerun price when the model warns that a rerun at that price holds a lower multiple
rule_definitions.margin_of_safety_price: the same test with the base at 13% a year in both lenses (bull >= 17%, bear >= -10% unchanged), the rerun price when the model warns: never above buy_test_price (16.11.2026)
rule_definitions.base_13_price: the base case alone (our lens) at 13% a year: a ladder rung, not an entry price

display.rule: in one year = the fiscal year-end within 92 days of as_of + 1 year, else that exact day (log-linear between the dated values); in five years = the horizon year-end the returns are computed to

historical_multiple.source: FY2028 operating EPS at the 75% guide 16.28 (orderly world, model) x the own 5-year median forward P/E 23.1 (p25-p75 18.9-32.9, measured 12.11.2026, not re-measured); pre-call consensus EPS 15.85 (Alpha Vantage, 18.11) gives about 366
historical_multiple.note: the old multiple was paid for 100%+ growth; at 15x about 244
